final.label: verify-automated-findings

skill_entry.name: 14. A bot finding is traced to the deciding line before it is endorsed, refuted or forwarded
skill_entry.trigger: The PR has an inline comment by cursor[bot] (Cursor Bugbot; REST login `cursor[bot]`, GraphQL author login `cursor`; the body carries `BUGBOT_BUG_ID` and a `**<Low|Medium|High> Severity**` line) whose thread is neither resolved nor outdated at the reviewed head, carries no author reply, and sits on a C++ line under h/, src/ or t/ that the diff adds or changes. Or the reviewer ran an agent review (Claude, GPT) of the whole diff. Graphite (`graphite-app[bot]`) and Codex (`chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]`) comments are out of scope: none of Wade's 14 bot replies answers one, and every such comment in the corpus is on a PR he approved in silence (2774, 3756, 4353, asim-330).
skill_entry.procedure:
1. Fetch the review threads (GraphQL reviewThreads: isResolved, isOutdated, first author) and the REST bodies. Per live finding write (symbol, claimed state, claimed consequence) and the severity word.
2. Bin: SENTINEL (a declared default such as `-1` reaches a callee), UNREACHABLE (a branch or default argument can no longer be taken), UNUSED, DUPLICATE-CONSTANT, CONCURRENCY.
3. SENTINEL: at the hunk line name the object the value is read from and its constructor. Grep the resolving initializer and every production constructor call. REFUTED when each call passes the resolved copy; quote the initializer.
4. UNREACHABLE: table the gate's input states; read the PR title and body. INTENDED when they name the behavior and the opt-in branch still enables.
5. UNUSED, DUPLICATE-CONSTANT, CONCURRENCY: run the owning check (dead symbol, re-derivation, shared state). A quoted invariant refutes; a stated race confirms; neither is UNKNOWN.
6. Verdict per finding with the deciding file:line.
skill_entry.question: Read at HEAD, which line decides the bot's claim (the initializer the value passes through, a caller that passes the parameter, or the PR title or body sentence that names the behavior as the goal), does it agree with the bot, and did you quote it?
skill_entry.do_not_fire: A thread with any author reply (2879602159 'It gets used, just not where this tool seems to be able to find it' and 2926693092 'Notified the FPGA team about this.' closed them for Wade with no line quoted; raise a real item under the owning check, as he did in 2941308844); a resolved or outdated thread; a claim on a line the diff does not add or change (3776964572 fake.cpp:169 exists at BASE; 3149408014 ranged_mask.cpp:20 is context); a claim decided by a number (divisor, bound, overflow: 2879962155, 3149408014, and 3156982388 left unanswered on his own loud PR 2565); a duplicate-constant or name claim (2879962438); a finding on a script, README, JSON or register-map file (1727, 2180, 4353; all 14 replies are on C++ files); the flagged behavior when the title or body names it as the purpose (3659990818); a dead parameter the bot adds in passing (`default_enabled`); forwarded agent items marked optional (C41: never a blocker). Never re-grade severity, recompute numbers or post CHANGES_REQUESTED.
skill_entry.finding_shape: Refute: "this is a false positive... `<member>` is initialized like this: <quoted initializer, file:line>, so when <input> is not given it inherits <resolved value>". Confirm: "I think this is a legit concern... did you run <test> to see if you hit <symptom>?" or "I do think there's merit to this complaint. <mechanism in your own words, file:line>". Intended: "that's the point of this PR... '<state>' leaves it <value>, and `<opt-in>` still turns it on. Looks fine to me.". Unknown (only with a named run or unit case): "was this intentional?". Forward: "I did ask claude to do a review as well. Below are the items it came up with. I do think there's some merit to a few of them, but could be a follow-up if you prefer."
skill_entry.severity_wade_uses: None for a refutation or an intended-behavior answer: he approved PR 3488 22 s after 3659990818 (review 4790383475, 18:45:25Z and 18:45:47Z). A confirmed claim is 'a legit concern' (3156090573), stated as a question naming the test that would show it, or 'merit to this complaint' (2983833171), stated as the mechanism in his own words; neither is a block. Forwarded agent items are 'some merit... could be a follow-up if you prefer. I'll approve as-is' (4800935083). A cleanup is 'please clean this up' (2915281512). He never writes CHANGES_REQUESTED, never re-grades the bot's severity word, and leaves findings he cannot decide from the code unanswered (3075799778 on 2426, 3156982388 on 2565).
skill_entry.evidence_scope: hunk + other files (the initializer and every caller at HEAD) + PR title and body + the review-thread state (resolved, outdated, author reply); runtime only as a question to the author (a multi-user run) when the code alone cannot decide.

final.procedure_commands:
## Check 14: a bot finding is traced to the deciding line

Common setup change (applies to every check): `BASEREF=$(gh pr view N --json baseRefName -q .baseRefName); BASE=$(git -C WT merge-base $HEAD origin/$BASEREF)`. On PR 2426 (base_ref bill-hwsync1) this gives 1a88e897e1; `merge-base HEAD origin/main` gives 5f37572171, the wrong BASE.

1. Threads: `gh api graphql -f query='query($n:Int!){repository(owner:"positron-ai",name:"tron"){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:60){nodes{isResolved isOutdated comments(first:3){nodes{databaseId path line author{login}}}}}}}}' -F n=N > threads.json`. Keep threads whose first author login is `cursor` (GraphQL drops the `[bot]` suffix), isResolved false, isOutdated false, and whose comments list has one node (no author reply). Verified on PR 2426: 3 cursor threads; 3075799768 and 3075799795 resolved with a Wado-posi reply, 3075799778 unresolved and unanswered.
2. Bodies: `gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/pulls/N/comments --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.user.login | endswith("[bot]")) | [.id, .path, .line, .commit_id[0:10], (.body | capture("\\*\\*(?<s>[A-Za-z]+) Severity\\*\\*").s), (.body | split("<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->")[1] | split("<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->")[0] | gsub("\n";" "))] | @tsv'`. Verified on PR 2426: 3 rows with id, path, line, commit, High / Medium / Low and the defect paragraph. Keep `.body | split("\n")[0]` only as the heading column. Line in diff: `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- <path> | grep -n '^@@'` and check the flagged line lies inside a new-side range; a context line does not fire.
3. SENTINEL: `git -C WT show HEAD:<file> | sed -n '<line-5>,<line+2>p'` names the expression; `git -C WT show HEAD:<file> | grep -n '<object>\b'` finds the member declaration and the constructor that receives it. Initializer: `git -C WT grep -n -E '<member>\(|with_<member>\(' HEAD -- h src | grep -E 'cfg->|with_<member>|<ObjectType>'`. A hit that copies the member without a sentinel test (`, max_layers(config.max_layers)`) is not the resolving initializer; keep only a hit whose enclosing constructor receives the object type named at the call site. Constructor calls: `git -C WT grep -n -E ', <Type>\(|<Type>_t [a-z_]+\(|\b<Type>\(\*' HEAD -- h src t` (member-initializer form, alias-declared variable, pointer-deref first argument); if more than 30 hits, add the first argument's spelling from the signature. REFUTED when every production call passes the resolved copy; quote the initializer file:line.
4. UNREACHABLE: `git -C WT show HEAD:<gate file> | cat -n`; write the table of input states to results. `gh pr view N --repo positron-ai/tron --json title -q .title`; `grep -n -i '<behavior words>' body.md`. INTENDED when the title or a body sentence names the behavior and the opt-in branch still returns the enabling value. A parameter the change leaves dead is a cleanup note, not a finding.
5. UNUSED: run check "dead symbol" (`git -C WT grep -n '<symbol>(' HEAD -- h src t ingest`; header: `git -C WT grep -n -E '#include.*<file>' HEAD -- h src t`), record each caller file:line and the argument in the claimed position, and grep the enclosing function family too so that 'only caller' claims name every hit. Re-read the bot sentence for a same-spelled member (`git -C WT show HEAD:<file> | grep -n '<symbol>'`); answer the sentence as written and name the reading you answered. DUPLICATE-CONSTANT: run the re-derivation check. CONCURRENCY: run the shared-state check; `git -C WT grep -n -i -E '<container>.*(lock|mutex|append-only|only grows|never removed|single writer)' HEAD -- h src`. A quoted invariant: REFUTED. A TODO or Note that names the hazard: CONFIRMED. Neither: UNKNOWN.
6. Verdict per live finding, with the deciding file:line, recorded in the report: REFUTED / CONFIRMED / INTENDED / UNKNOWN. Post only a verdict that quotes its deciding line (an initializer, a caller, a title or body sentence). Post UNKNOWN only when you can name the run or unit case that would show the symptom (multi-user run, shared-page case); otherwise leave the thread unanswered.
7. Agent review run by the reviewer: keep an item only if it names (a) a copied upstream implementation (`git -C WT grep -n '#undef\|<upstream macro prefix>' HEAD -- <copying header>` and a version or commit pin in its comment); (b) a gate in one header bypassed by direct includes elsewhere (`git -C WT grep -n -E '#include *<<upstream>' HEAD -- h src | grep -v <gating header>`); (c) a process-global relaxed atomic with no single-writer comment (`grep -n -i 'single.writer\|one writer' <header>`); (d) a README claim absent from the `--help` string. Forward kept items in one quoted block, say which have merit, mark them optional, approve.

On PR 2426 (head 4666560ff1, base 1a88e897e1, 3 cursor threads): 3075799768 SENTINEL at h/tron/models/model.hpp:829 `cfg.max_layers`; `cfg` is `state::cfg` (:617), initialized by the lambda at :803-808 of the constructor at :802; initializer grep gives 12 hits, the filter keeps h/tron/scheduler/full.hpp:1060-1062 (`cfg->max_layers == -1 ? model_t::n_layers : cfg->max_layers`) and config.hpp:42-46 `with_max_layers`, drops llama.hpp:437 (plain copy), full.hpp:275, kv_cache.hpp:236, gof.cpp:63, gof.hpp:167; narrowed constructor grep gives 3 hits: model.hpp:813 (self_attn_state, different member), full.hpp:1063 `state(*llm, std::move(cfg->with_max_layers(max_layers)))`, t/t_llama_unit.cpp:296 `state_t state(*model, model_config{.max_layers = n_layers})`; verdict REFUTED (matches 3082075451; Wade's text names llama.cpp, which does not exist at that commit). 3075799795 UNUSED at h/tron/gof.hpp:89 parameter `pages`; callers model.hpp:1598 `g->populate(n_kv_heads, head_size, layer, dev, job.gal_ptr->pages)`, t/t_phase1_integration.cpp:835 and :869; the bot's sentence names the member `page_info pages[gof_tokens]` at gof.hpp:73 (written at :81-84), still present; verdict REFUTED for the parameter reading (matches 3088359578), member reading unanswered. 3075799778 CONCURRENCY at full.hpp:962-966 (span returned under lock_guard, iterated by gof.cpp:189); 10 `gals` mutation sites, 0 invariant comments; verdict UNKNOWN; Wade posted nothing. gof_configure production callers: model.hpp:828-829 and src/tron/gof_model.cpp:12-13 (passes `model_t::n_layers`).

On PR 3488 (head 2a3fb52d5a, in WT): 3659990818 UNREACHABLE at src/tron/models/hw_attn_config.cpp:16 `return false;`; states unset -> false (:16), `=0` -> false and `=1` -> true (:13-14); fwd_hw_attn_enabled :24 returns `*env`, so `default_enabled` (:25) is dead; caller h/tron/models/model.hpp:539; title 'flip HW attention off by default in a way that's easy to toggle back on'; hpp:10-12 documents the three states; verdict INTENDED (matches 3659990818; approval 4790383475 22 s later).

On PR 3490 (review 4800935083; reviewed head 6e3f089cce is not in the worktree, needs `gh pr diff 3490 --repo positron-ai/tron`): four forwarded items: perfetto.hpp copied macro without a version pin, bypass by direct `#include <perfetto` outside h/common/perfetto.hpp, relaxed atomics with no single-writer note, `--trace-passes` help text behind the README; 'I'll approve as-is.'
final.widen_delta: New check 14, added after check 13 in SKILL.md and references/procedures.md. SKILL.md "The thirteen questions" becomes fourteen with question 14: "Bot finding: which line at HEAD (initializer, caller, or the PR title) decides the claim, and is it quoted?". "Words used here" gains: Bot finding (an inline comment by cursor[bot], Cursor Bugbot; REST login `cursor[bot]`, GraphQL login `cursor`); Agent review (a Claude or GPT review the reviewer ran on the whole diff); Sentinel default (a declared default such as -1 that an initializer replaces before use); Live thread (a review thread neither resolved nor outdated at the reviewed head, with no author reply). Common setup in procedures.md: BASE is computed against the PR's base ref (`gh pr view N --json baseRefName`), not origin/main; PR 2426 (base bill-hwsync1) gives 1a88e897e1 instead of 5f37572171. Setup step 1 gains: save the review threads (GraphQL reviewThreads with isResolved, isOutdated and first author) next to the body for every PR; the REST comments list cannot tell a closed thread from an open one, and the fetch does not depend on a trigger. "How Wade words a finding" gains one bullet: a reply to a bot is a verdict plus the deciding line, never a restatement of the bot's text; forwarded agent items are quoted, judged ("some merit") and marked optional. "Report the result" gains two items: list each live bot finding with its verdict (refuted / confirmed / intended / unknown) and the file:line that decided it, and post only those whose deciding line is quoted; before posting any finding of your own that was made from a declaration, a default value or a signature, open the initializer, the callers and the PR body (the same trace as check 14 applied to yourself; moved here from the draft's trigger clause (c)). Draft trigger clause (b) (`<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->` in the body) is deleted: the block is a summary with no claim, it appears on 26 of the 48 silent PRs, and the thread fetch now runs on every PR regardless. Description line of the skill gains "bot findings endorsed without the initializer or caller that decides them".
